ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (cream/white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity dark pigment forms a central T-shaped cluster extending from the fluke-to-body insertion point toward the median notch. Distal tips of both lobes exhibit solid low-intensity borders. The remaining macro-surface area of both lobes consists of high-intensity cream-colored pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angled V-shaped depression at the center of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; high-amplitude peaks are visible on the distal ends of the right and left lobes, with finer-frequency pixel variations occurring closer to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edge extending to the tips, with a multi-modal undulating curve along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of low-intensity circular spots visible on the mid-section of the left lobe; high-intensity pixel clusters (potential barnacle scarring) localized on the outer margin of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) observed on the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable linear scarring/rake marks on the right lobe; orange-brown discoloration/lesion visible on the outer-right boundary edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark mottling pattern on the interior of the left lobe that does not mirror the right lobe's pigmentation.
